description: Card statements beside a Standard History card and the card_registered report (§13). Generated by python/scripts/generate_card_registration_v0_vectors.py. The card is person-3-months of vectors/standard-history-v0/vectors.json, as JCS octets. Times are NumericDates; service keys are hex DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo test keys and the holder key a raw Ed25519 key identifier, all derived from public labels.
